🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT, until Mon 2 Nov!
• Turn right after START: 10 spooky stages
• Beat all 10 to win the Spooky Speeder + Pumpkin Trail
• Earn the Spooky paint halfway

Fly a rocket car through 40 stages, from the city to SPACE! 🚀

🌍 FOUR WORLDS
• Thrust City: wall rides, loops, ramps and lava
• Star Circuit: neon tracks and rings in space
• Lava Planet: geysers, fire rings and an eruption
• Ice Planet: ski jumps, bobsleds and an avalanche
• Pick Easy, Normal or Hard

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
• W drive, A/D steer
• Hold SPACE to fly, tap to hop
• F to flip, ride the striped walls
• 📱 Phone: stick + THRUST and FLIP buttons

🏅 Medals, coins, keys and a free daily spin
🎨 Collect paints and exhaust effects
🎁 Use code OG for a free limited paint!

👑 VIP: 2x coins, unlimited skips, unlimited gas, +25% speed and the Velvet Galaxy paint

📱 Phone, tablet, PC and controller
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more!

⚠️This is a fan-made Roadster game. We are not associated with Tesla Roadster ⚠️
